warnings: Split-plot design with 3 replications - ensure n=3 for all extractions
Multiple application timings (24, 45, 58 days after emergence) must be extracted separately
Multiple doses (0, 5, 10, 20 l/ha) with dose 0 as control
Statistical analysis uses variance components and HSD values provided
Some measurements show 'ns' (not significant) which may indicate no extractable variance
Tables show both individual timing/dose combinations and means

WARNING: VAR-UNCLEAR - Variance type not clearly stated
recon.variance_source: HSD iis 0.3 % 11.9 g (from Table 2) and Comparisons of means were done according to Tukey's HSD
recon.treatment_definition: 5, 10, or 20 l/ha seaweed extract SM3 applied at different timings
recon.potential_tc_confusion: Tables show both individual dose/timing combinations and pooled means - must extract individual combinations vs control
recon.extraction_guidance: Extract each dose (5, 10, 20 l/ha) at each timing (July 10, July 31, August 15) separately against the untreated control. Use HSD values where provided. Focus on tuber yield and ware yield as primary outcomes. Note that Figure 2 may contain additional yield data not in tables.
